```{r -Standardising the dataset/ join them by two datasets based on island location}
# Exercise 1

clean_metadata <- island_metadata %>% 
  mutate(
    island_name = str_to_title(island_name),
    station_install = ymd(c(
      "2003/01/15",
      "2004/03/22",
      "2001/11/05"
    ))
  )

# Exercise 2

penguins_spatial <- left_join(
  clean_metadata,
  penguins,
  by = c("island_name" = "island")
)

```

```{r -Establishing highest penguin body mass with island prescene included}

Max_body_mass <- penguins %>%

  group_by(species, island) %>%
  summarise(
```

```{r Rename}

E_metdata <- E_metdata %>%
  mutate(site_name = case_match(
    site_name,
    "Upper_Ross" ~ "Upper Ross",
    " mid_ross"  ~ "Mid Ross",
    "LOWER ROSS" ~ "Lower Ross",
    "ross_mouth" ~ "Ross Mouth",
    .default = site_name
  ))

E_metdata %>%
  filter(site_name == "Ross Mouth")
E_metdata <- E_metdata %>%
  rename(site = `site_name`)

E_metdata <- E_metdata %>%
  mutate(
    site = if_else(site == "mid_ross", "Mid Ross", site)
  )




```


```{r Rename 2}
E_sonde<- En_sonde %>%
  mutate(site = case_when(
    site %in% c("mid_ross", "Mid_ross", "MID_ROSS", "Mid_Ross") ~ "Mid Ross",
    site %in% c("lower_ross", "Lower_ross", "LOWER ROSS")      ~ "Lower Ross",
    site %in% c("upper_ross", "Upper_ross", "Upper_Ross")      ~ "Upper Ross",
    site %in% c("ross_mouth", "Ross_mouth", "ROSS MOUTH")      ~ "Ross Mouth",
    TRUE ~ site # leaves any other site name unchanged
  ))

fish2<- fish%>%
  mutate(site = case_when(
    site %in% c("mid_ross", "Mid_ross", "MID_ROSS", "Mid_Ross") ~ "Mid Ross",
    site %in% c("lower_ross", "Lower_ross", "LOWER ROSS")      ~ "Lower Ross",
    site %in% c("upper_ross", "Upper_ross", "Upper_Ross")      ~ "Upper Ross",
    site %in% c("ross_mouth", "Ross_mouth", "ROSS MOUTH")      ~ "Ross Mouth",
    TRUE ~ site # leaves any other site name unchanged
  ))

E_metdata <- E_metdata%>%
  mutate(site = case_match(
    site,
    "Upper Ross" ~ "Upper Ross",
    " mid ross"   ~ "Mid Ross",
    "Lower_ross" ~ "Lower Ross",
    "ROSS MOUTH" ~ "Ross Mouth",
    .default = site 
  ))

fish$species <- recode(
 fish$species,
 "barramundi" = "Lates calcarifer",
  "MANGROVE JACK" = "Lutjanus argentimaculatus",
  "bream" = "Acanthopagrus australis",
  "flathead" = "Platycephalus fuscus"
)

fish2 <- fish2 %>%
  mutate(
    site = if_else(site == "Lower ross", "Lower Ross", site)
  )



```


```{r clean-sonde}
E_sonde <- En_sonde %>%
  mutate(turbidity = na_if(turbidity, -999))

S<- En_sonde %>%
  mutate(site = case_when(
    site %in% c("mid_ross", "Mid_ross", "MID_ROSS", "Mid_Ross") ~ "Mid Ross",
    site %in% c("lower_ross", "Lower_ross", "LOWER ROSS")      ~ "Lower Ross",
    site %in% c("upper_ross", "Upper_ross", "Upper_Ross")      ~ "Upper Ross",
    site %in% c("ross_mouth", "Ross_mouth", "ROSS MOUTH")      ~ "Ross Mouth",
    TRUE ~ site # leaves any other site name unchanged
  ))



```

```{r combining datasets}
library(lubridate)

head(dmy_hm(S$timestamp))
S <- S %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = dmy_hm(timestamp)
  )

head(S$datetime)
range(S$datetime)

S_daily <- S %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) %>%
  group_by(site, date) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_temp = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_salinity = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_turbidity = mean(turbidity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

range(S_daily$date)
metadata <- f3 %>%
  left_join(S_daily, by = c("site", "date"))

Total <- metadata %>%
  group_by(site, zone) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

```{r Table creation}
#Summary table displaying mean count/ mean salinity depending on zone with sd included 
summary_table <- Total %>%
  group_by(species, zone) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_count = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sal = mean(mean_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sal = sd(mean_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(summary_table)


```

```{r Plotting}
"Figure 2: Daily predatory fish catch abundance trends plotted against estuarine spatial boundaries. Faded points represent underlying jittered field observations."
summary_table |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = zone, y = mean_count, fill = species)) +
  geom_line(group = 1) +
  # add in points from master data
  geom_point(data = summary_table, aes(x = zone, y = mean_count),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.2, size = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) + 
  geom_point(position = "dodge", size = 4, pch = 23) +
  # SE pretty narrow, potentially not worth plotting but let's viewer see that included
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_count - sd_count, ymax = mean_count + sd_count), 
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.2) + 
  facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "fixed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, colour = "grey20"), # spp names in italic
    # legend.position = "bottom"
    legend.position = "none" # legend unnecessary
  ) +
  labs(
    #title = "Predatory Fish Abundance across Estuarine Salinity Gradients", # default ggplot title appears on top
    #subtitle = "Ross River Estuary System, May 2026",
    x = "Spatial Zone",
    # scientific label for y axis of n day -1 use regex to get superscript
    y = expression("Abundance (n day"^-1*")"),
    #  y = "Daily abundance (n day^-1)"
    y = "Abundance (per day)"
  )


```




```{r Salinity}

#Median Salinity 
S_daily <- S %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) %>%
  group_by(site, date) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_temp = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_salinity = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_salinity = median(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_salinity = sd(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_turbidity = mean(turbidity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


#Median Salinity 


glimpse(Total)

T2 <- Total %>%
  left_join(
    S_daily %>%
      select(site, date, median_salinity, sd_salinity),
    by = c("site", "date")
  )

#### Remake salinity plot nicely for publication
#| fig-cap: "Salinity Gradient across zones. Ross River Estuary System, Townsville, NQ, Australia May 2026."

#Calculating the median 

summary2_table <- T2 %>%
  group_by(species, zone) %>%
  summarise(
    median_sal = median(median_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_salinity = sd(median_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary2_table)
#Median Salinity data

plot_data <- T2 %>%
  group_by(zone) %>%
  summarise(
    median_sal = median(median_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_salinity = sd(median_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = zone, y = median_sal)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = median_sal - sd_salinity,
      ymax = median_sal + sd_salinity
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Zone",
    y = "Median Salinity (ppt)"
  )

 


```
